book_title: 小蓝本高中卷9 不等式的解题与技巧
title: 一些非“对称”不等式的处理方法
solution_md:
解析 (1) $a^2 + b^2 + T = a^2 + b^2 + (a + b)(c + d) + ab + bc + cd \geqslant 2ab + 2\sqrt{ab} \cdot 2\sqrt{cd} + ab + cd = 4 + 3ab + cd \geqslant 4 + 2\cdot\sqrt{3abcd} = 4 + 2\sqrt{3}$. 当 $a = b, c = d, 3ab = cd$, 即 $a = b = \left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{\frac{1}{4}}$, $c = d = 3^{\frac{3}{4}}$ 时等号成立.
(2) $a^2 + b^2 + c^2 + T \geqslant 3\sqrt[3]{a^2b^2c^2} + 3\sqrt[3]{abc} \cdot d + 3\sqrt[3]{(abc)^2} \geqslant 6\sqrt{2}$. 等号当 $a = b = c = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{4}}$, $d = 2^{\frac{3}{4}}$ 时取到.
original_text_md:
设 $a, b, c, d \in \mathbf{R}_+$, $abcd = 1$, 令 $T = a(b + c + d) + b(c + d) + cd$.
(1) 求 $a^2 + b^2 + T$ 的最小值;
(2) 求 $a^2 + b^2 + c^2 + T$ 的最小值.
解析 (1) $a^2 + b^2 + T = a^2 + b^2 + (a + b)(c + d) + ab + bc + cd \geqslant 2ab + 2\sqrt{ab} \cdot 2\sqrt{cd} + ab + cd = 4 + 3ab + cd \geqslant 4 + 2\cdot\sqrt{3abcd} = 4 + 2\sqrt{3}$. 当 $a = b, c = d, 3ab = cd$, 即 $a = b = \left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{\frac{1}{4}}$, $c = d = 3^{\frac{3}{4}}$ 时等号成立.
(2) $a^2 + b^2 + c^2 + T \geqslant 3\sqrt[3]{a^2b^2c^2} + 3\sqrt[3]{abc} \cdot d + 3\sqrt[3]{(abc)^2} \geqslant 6\sqrt{2}$. 等号当 $a = b = c = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{4}}$, $d = 2^{\frac{3}{4}}$ 时取到.
